title: Cosmic Lava Titan
description: A muscular humanoid figure made of dark cracked stone with glowing orange lava flowing through its body stands in a volcanic landscape. Its chest and head contain swirling galaxy and nebula patterns while it raises one hand holding a glowing spiral galaxy against a starry cosmic sky with dramatic light beams.
